ab702a529db7.sql:
SELECT event_name, p50, p75, w, m FROM (WITH h AS (
		SELECT "event_name", bucket, CASE WHEN bucket = -1000 THEN 0 ELSE 2 * pow(1.04, bucket) / 2.04 END AS approx_value,
			count(*) AS samples, SUM(1 / sample_rate) AS w, SUM(value / sample_rate) AS s
		FROM measures WHERE "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-10' AND DATE '2026-09-10' AND true GROUP BY "event_name", bucket),
	c AS (SELECT "event_name", samples, w, s, approx_value, SUM(w) OVER (PARTITION BY "event_name" ORDER BY bucket) AS run, SUM(w) OVER (PARTITION BY "event_name") AS total FROM h)
	SELECT "event_name", SUM(samples), SUM(w), SUM(s) / SUM(w), MIN(approx_value) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.5 * total), MIN(approx_value) FILTER (WHERE run >= 0.75 * total) FROM c GROUP BY "event_name" ORDER BY "event_name") t(event_name, n, w, m, p50, p75) ORDER BY event_name
